notes:
- Added an option to mark inventory items as junk, similar to locking.
- Locked items cannot be marked as junk. Junk items cannot be locked.
- Junk items cannot be equipped or banked.
- Marking an item as junk marks all exact copies of that item as junk (including picking up new ones) until you unmark it as junk.
- Junk is saved per-character.
- Added a "Sell all junk" button to the Guild Merchant's trade window.
- Fixed an issue where Spark Master choices were not saved in skill presets.
